caption: The drawing is done in grayscale pencil on off-white paper and features a highly detailed depiction of a pitcher or jug as the central object. The main pitcher has a round, bulbous body with a smoothly contoured surface, a pronounced curved pouring lip, and a single large, ornate handle extending from the top edge in an elaborate S-curve with decorative flourishes. The pitcher stands on three decorated feet, each foot ending in a form resembling a claw with leaf-like embellishments above. Below the main drawing are three smaller sketches: the lower left shows a front view of the pitcher with measurements, the center bottom displays a top view with dimensions, and the lower right provides front and side elevations of the handle. All lines are rendered in pencil and the shading gives the objects a three-dimensional appearance, with annotations and measurements written neatly on the page. The entire composition is organized within faintly drawn rectangular borders.
title: Pewter Pitcher
